name: Node-RED
description: Créez des flux d'automatisation en glisser-déposer.
compose:
services:
  nodered:
    image: nodered/node-red:latest
    container_name: nodered
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "{{PUID}}:{{PGID}}"
    environment:
      - TZ={{TZ}}
    ports:
      - "1880:1880"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/data
